cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've circled the receipt number like you. Proof I've solved the missing-money problem. Put my name beside that in the report.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The circle means check it. We still need to see whether that payment went through twice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, checking my discovery. Compare the bank entries under that number.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are two. I'll list everyone who helped find the duplicate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List them. Put 'found the receipt' beside my name, so I don't disappear into 'helped'.
